propositions: Five test modules repeatedly build equivalent virgin git-backed store topologies from scratch for every test consumer, contributing 103.416 aggregate worker-seconds across the top five modules in Verify run 31846417650.
Runtime probes confirmed that real-build versus isolated-copy ratios ranged from 12x to 23x across the five fixture builders, proving setup (not test bodies) dominates the measured >1s spans.

The clone_topology_template helper initially violated the per-test isolation contract by copying asymmetric op-cert private keys verbatim, leaving distinct per-test environments authenticated with a shared private key until repaired.

A session-scoped template with per-test isolated copies and proper isolation guards (reminted identities, distinct worktree refs, per-test gate snapshots, virgin templates, no shared object stores) reduced fixture setup overhead while preserving all initialization/recovery contracts and test coverage.
All 125 affected tests passed after the fix; no test, assertion, or selector was removed, skipped, sampled, xfailed, or weakened.
